notes.title: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos Release Coming November 4!
notes.content:
Release date confirmed: November 4, 2025 🎉


Hi everyone!
We’ve got some exciting news: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos will officially launch on November 4, 2025. Mark your calendars, because chaos is coming!




[previewyoutube="QiVZsfM92do;full"][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]🔨 What we’ve been working on
Over the past months, our small indie team has been polishing the game and making sure the cleaning chaos feels as fun (and unpredictable!) as possible. Here’s a peek:

New tools – from vacuums to… “less conventional” devices 🤪

Physics tweaks – smoother chaos, funnier fails, better co-op experience

Cats – yes, even more cats, and they’re cheekier than ever 🐱

Levels – new environments to test your teamwork… or destroy it
[hr][/hr]🎮 Why “Cleaning Chaos”?
We always wanted to make a co-op game that mixes teamwork and trolling. You can try to clean properly, but it’s just as much fun to knock over your friend’s bucket, ride a vacuum, or let a cat steal your tools. It’s that mix of order and disaster that makes every session unpredictable.
[hr][/hr]👀 What’s next?
Playtests are open sign up now! Your feedback helps us a ton.

Wishlist on Steam to get notified on launch day:
 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117430/Purrrifiers_Cleaning_Chaos/"][/dynamiclink]

More sneak peeks coming in future devlogs – including behind-the-scenes looks at level design, cat AI, and chaos physics.
[hr][/hr]💬 Join the chaos
We’d love to hear from you!

Are you Team Clean 🧽 or Team Chaos 💥?

Which cat behavior would you love to see in the game?

Drop a comment, share your ideas, and get ready for November 4!

Thanks for supporting us – you’re the reason we can keep making silly, chaotic games like this. ❤️



— The Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos dev team

notes.title: First thoughts after your feedback!
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players!
or should I say Dear Purrrifiers?

We would like to thank you for all of your feedback. It's very important for us to understand how you feel with the game. We gathered over 3.000 answers and guest what... we read every single one of them!

We also watched many youtubers and streamers who were playing our game and OMG it was hilarious to watch. There is CHAOS! But the most precious thing was to see you players smiling and laughing during the game.

We received many positive messages which put a smile on our faces:

notes.title: We Reveal!
notes.content:
Hello Purrrifers!

Today we want to reveal a bit more about the game. Here we will share some key stuff you'll find in Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/a88b6e73c7094ff3715fb4d562b0f036e8a128c3.png

CORE OF THE GAME:

Single Player - Experience the game in a solo mode where you can tackle challenges on your own.

Online Co-op - Team up with friends online to clean and solve puzzles together in cooperative multiplayer mode.

Story - Immerse yourself in a story-driven experience filled with quirky characters and unexpected twists.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/3fbafc234562bcc9ee531f775b468d98831fcfa0.gif

Creative Freedom - lots, lots of ways to have fun (more about it in next devlog)

Lots of references and jokes - Enjoy numerous pop culture references and humor scattered throughout the game.

Open World - Explore a vast open world filled with interactive environments and diverse areas to clean and conquer.

https://i.imgur.com/uiOMqYt.gif

Replayability - Each mission can be completed in various ways, affecting dialogues and outcomes.

Loads of events and quests - Encounter dynamic events like street protests, appliance malfunctions, and even dealing with personal emergencies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/41e9321315580d30d782be6d33c3c402e9b03218.gif

Randomness - Discover random occurrences on the map that add surprise and variety to your gameplay.


MAIN FEATURES

Chemicals- Utilize different cleaning agents and chemicals to tackle various stains and dirt.

Riddles - Solve engaging puzzles that require wit and strategy.

Players Interactions -  Interact with other players in various ways, both cooperatively and competitively.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/e94b917ef3b8cbdf36f7dab502968e52462f5727.gif

Household appliances -  Operate a variety of cleaning appliances like washing machines, dishwashers, refrigerators, ovens, pressure washers, mops, and brooms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/a58e23316b77a82f8a9c469b24505224dfb8f487.gif

Player Base - Design and build your dream home, serving as your base of operations.

Customization - Develop your profile by unlocking outfits, trinkets, pets, and more.


KEY MECHANICS

Dirt - Engage in the detailed process of cleaning dirt using various tools like pressure washers, sponges, and scrubbers (including ones with cute faces).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/c1ee13920db0973b6b33cc9d9611c5c10e0e9384.gif

Cleaning process - Follow the entire cleaning processes step by step, such as gathering clothes, loading the washing machine, adding detergent, starting the cycle, hanging clothes to dry, and storing them in the closet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/5e844f825cf0c400ee14c62d1200a2e7b2bcaf22.gif

Garbage - Collect and sort trash and other items, organizing them into the appropriate bins (dishes in the dishwasher, clothes in the washing machine).

https://i.imgur.com/ssobEM7.gif

CATS - Experience interactions and gameplay elements involving cats that add to the chaos and fun.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/d59aa5d158d6e29ffb11afab68d7e30dbe7bd049.gif

Vehicles - Drive and operate vehicles like lawnmowers, garbage trucks, and street sweepers as part of your cleaning duties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/ee9fc6366dd73dc7aaadbc71d79d102f2d261028.gif


OTHER FEATURES:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/42480a75c099e84485989ca27e21f38b395b6b46.png

Eastereggs - Discover hidden secrets, Easter eggs, and collectibles by exploring every nook and cranny.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/82203b0dc5b8c49374adcab8733630bea93d23a8.gif

Interactions -  Experiment with environmental interactions, such as spraying water on an outlet to cause a power outage that disables all electronics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/1e98b8d8b0b649aaa1f2c613efd0596064ded0e9.gif

Theft - Engage in or prevent thefts within homes, adding a layer of challenge and strategy.

Furniture - Arrange and customize furniture to your liking, enhancing your environment.

NPC's - Engage in dialogues and accept quests from NPCs, enriching the game's narrative and world.

Dying - Face the consequences of your actions, including potential dangers that can lead to your character's demise.

Ragdoll - Enjoy the comical and unpredictable physics of ragdoll animations during gameplay.


From now on, we will be showing screenshots, gifs, videos and streams about what you can see above... and more! Stay tuned. 

Tell your friend to wishlist the game, as the more of us, the merrier!



Purrrifiers team

notes.title: We Work!
notes.content:
Welcome to our next devlog. We will tell you how we work on the Purrrifiers Cleaning Chaos game.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/2fdf28848815f6ebfeadb5c21fbc62f1ba2f69ba.png

Currently, there are mainly two people working on the game and a few people for specific tasks. So, as you can see, we are a compact team. We plan to expand the team, but everything depends on the success of the game.

We chose the Unity engine to create the game. We have more experience in it, and therefore we can work more and faster. We are currently working on the first demo mission and building the entire game core. In the case of multiplayer and co-op games, many aspects of the game are more difficult than in the case of single-player games. We must constantly monitor the synchronization of objects in the world, take care of the quality of the connection, optimize everything by 4 times (since the game will be for 4 players).

As is often the case, many bugs appear during game production. Some of them might end up in the game, who knows? :)
Here is an example of such a bug from production:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/0c43a4a1a61ebf0f484ed822ac2315be676fbc32.png

We work hard on the game, but we believe that you will appreciate our efforts and will notice the humor and references. We love memes and jokes, so expect a lot of fun.

We work in a pleasant atmosphere, where we are accompanied by cats. As you have probably already noticed, they will be an important element of the game. 

We can't say too much what will be in the demo of the project, but we hope that we will gather our "cult" of fans ;)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/b3d582dfa1e26e30a1e1f87c2ea292faa938f56a.png

To sum up, cats, memes, coop? This has to work <3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065438/9ba799cf9e5cf033f3bd62b3b42ab27a00d245a7.png

notes.title: We Welcome!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce our latest project Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos - the ultimate casual multiplayer team-based game about the "next-gen" cleaning process, featuring all the ins and outs of the job. It’s up to you and your team how you want to complete the challenges.

Gameplay-wise, Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos is all about having a fun, creative approach to work. Who said working can't be pleasant and engaging?

We do not forget about single-player fans. The solo campaign featuring easter eggs, references to today's pop culture, relaxing gameplay, and unique story awaits!
